title: Span minimap & correlation anchors — compact timeline for rapid drilldowns
creator: Lena Chen
description:
Problem: Navigating long traces with hundreds of spans is slow and context switching between a high-level dashboard and a single request drilldown is awkward. Engineers and SREs need a compact overview that preserves correlation context (trace IDs/correlation IDs) while enabling rapid jump-to-span and cost/latency hotspots.

Goal: Design a ‘minimap’ timeline and correlation-anchor system that sits above the request/trace detail panel. The minimap shows an abstracted, compressed representation of span density, error/fault hotspots, and rollout/canary boundaries. Anchors in the minimap map directly to full span lists and timeline zoom levels. Provide fast filter handoffs (e.g., click an anchor to apply pre-populated filters and open the waterfall at the right offset). Integrate cost-per-request micro-metrics and rollout tag overlays so product/ops can correlate new model rollouts with latency/regression signals.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype in Figma demonstrating the minimap above the waterfall with at least three interaction states: overview, focused, and anchor-to-span transition
Clicking an anchor applies the intended filter set and scrolls the span timeline to the correct offset in the prototype
Minimap visually distinguishes error spans, high-token-cost segments, and canary/baseline overlays
Keyboard accessibility: Tab focus, left/right to pan minimap viewport, Enter to open anchor
Design notes include developer-facing specs for lazy-loading span detail and sampling tolerances (e.g., 95th percentile vs raw events)
Handoff doc includes API contract suggestions (minimap summary endpoint + anchor metadata) and a list of backend implications
design_notes:
High-level approach: compute a lightweight summarised timeline per request using pre-aggregated span buckets (e.g., 100ms bins) and surface three compact glyph types: density bands, error flags, and cost intensity heat. Use anchors as first-class metadata objects that reference span_id, trace_offset_ms, and a minimal context token (correlation id, rollout tag).

Trade-offs considered:
- Full fidelity vs summarised view: we prioritise a summary view to avoid loading 100s of spans immediately; clicking an anchor triggers lazy fetch.
- Anchor granularity: avoid over-cluttering by limiting anchors to top N hotspots (configurable) and allowing user to 'expand anchors' into sub-anchors.
- Rollout overlays: render semi-transparent lanes for canary vs baseline to help visual correlation; will require rollout-tagged spans from backend.

Performance constraints & backend needs:
- New endpoint: /traces/:id/minimap that returns bucketed metrics and anchor list (span_id, offset_ms, tags).
- Sampling guidance: if trace size > 500 spans, summarise to buckets and include representative span ids only for anchors.

Accessibility & motion:
- Reduced motion variant for minimap animations, ensure 4.5:1 contrast for glyphs, anchors must be keyboard-focusable with ARIA labels containing correlation-id and time offset.

Open questions:
- Should anchors persist across dashboard queries (sticky anchors) or be ephemeral per trace view? Recommend ephemeral initially, then add 'pin anchor' feature if user research indicates value.
- How to represent KV cache hits vs CPU-bound spans in the minimap? Need engineering mapping of span-level cost categories.
comments: 2025-02-15 - Marco Rivers: Kicked off exploratory sketches. Decided to prioritise density band and error markers. Blocker: need a backend shape for anchors; pinged infra team.
2025-02-18 - Priya Nair (PM): Reviewed concept. Request: include rollout-name and version tag in anchor metadata so we can correlate canary spikes without joining logs.

2025-02-20 - Sam Ortiz (Eng): Feasibility note: we can produce a minimap endpoint using existing span-summary job, but will need to add 'anchor' extraction in ingestion pipeline. Estimate 3 dev days + 1 integration day.

2025-02-24 - Design critique with UX team: Feedback to increase the tappable area for anchors on mobile and provide a tooltip with token-cost estimate. Also suggested a micro-interaction where anchors pulse when the trace has active alerts.
2025-02-26 - Marco Rivers: Updated Figma with focused -> anchor transition animation and keyboard behavior. Added reduced-motion frames. Uploaded specs to Confluence (link in attachments).
2025-02-28 - QA: Flag: ensure that minimap render degrades gracefully when trace timestamps are sparse or out-of-order; add a test case in the QA checklist.
2025-03-01 - Lena Chen: Merged final prototype into handoff doc and marked ready for engineering review. Added follow-up task to evaluate 'pinned anchors' after initial launch.
notes_for_engineering: Suggested API: GET /api/v1/traces/:trace_id/minimap -> { buckets: [{start_ms,end_ms,density,error_count,cost_score}], anchors: [{span_id,offset_ms,label,correlation_id,rollout_tag}] }. Recommend server-side summarisation to avoid query-time heavy operations. Include a sample payload in Confluence attachment.
next_steps: 1) Final engineering grooming with ENG-45211 to confirm data shape and SLO. 2) Build prototype telemetry to measure click-through on anchors and average time-to-first-detailed-span. 3) Schedule 2-hour design-engineering handoff session week of 2025-03-03.
